'''GrandWORMTarkin X-WING DECK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Player:''' [[GrandWORMTarkin]]

* '''GPN category:''' Standard

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed X-WING DECK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!.txt |Download]]

this deck is funny it probly wont win but if they deploy in space theyll have a sworm of x wings on'm. its also cheap and easy to make.

== Strategy ==

use projection of a skywalkers to block force drains at sites. use boush and tk to block force drain while under cover. use organized attack to get lots of x wings.
pound them when they come into space!
